platformStory.title: Restaurants do not need another disconnected app.
platformStory.intro: The dining room is a live system. A reservation affects the host stand. The host stand affects the table. The table affects the kitchen. The meal affects the review, the reward, and the next visit. Scerv is being built around that full loop.

steps.title: Reservations, waitlist, and host check-in
steps.copy: Let guests request the right experience while the restaurant controls rules, capacity, party flow, and table readiness.

steps.title: Parties, tables, servers, and kitchen flow
steps.copy: Keep the front and back of house aligned as guests order, staff route items, tables move, and service pressure rises.

steps.title: Payments, discounts, refunds, and receipts
steps.copy: Make payment easier for guests while giving operators clearer records of fees, taxes, gratuity, promos, and payouts.

steps.title: Reviews, rewards, offers, and guest memory
steps.copy: Turn every meal into better dish feedback, stronger loyalty signals, and more precise reasons for guests to come back.

platformStory.operatorLine: Scerv should feel invisible to the guest when service is great, and indispensable to the operator when the room gets complicated.

restaurants.title: Enterprise hospitality tools for independent restaurants

ordering.title: Connected Ordering and Checkout
ordering.desc: Let guests browse, order, split, and pay through a polished experience while staff keep service moving. Scerv is designed to reduce friction without removing hospitality from the room.

queue.title: Kitchen and Service Flow
queue.desc: Keep orders, tables, staff, and guest requests organized across the dining room and back of house. Clear routing helps teams reduce mistakes and protect the pace of service.

analytics.title: Operator Intelligence
analytics.desc: See the restaurant beyond transactions. Track sales, discounts, refunds, guest engagement, dish-level feedback, and the signals that help restaurants make better decisions.

solutions.title: The workflows restaurants actually fight every night
solutions.subtitle: Scerv is designed around the moments where service breaks down, margins leak, and guests decide whether they are coming back.

foh.headline: A calmer host stand and a smarter dining room
foh.desc: Track reservation intent, check-in requests, party status, table readiness, server assignment, and next actions in one place. The point is not to make service robotic. It is to give the team enough clarity to be warmer, faster, and more composed.

boh.headline: Protect the kitchen when the room gets loud
boh.desc: Route items clearly, keep table context attached to orders, and reduce the messy handoffs that create mistakes during rushes, split checks, modifications, and late-stage service changes.

guests.headline: Make guests feel known without being creepy
guests.desc: Help people find the right dish, join a party, check out without waiting, leave useful feedback, earn meaningful rewards, and return because the restaurant remembered what mattered.

footer.tagline: A modern hospitality platform for restaurants that want stronger service, smarter operations, and more repeat guests.

about.heroTitle: Building the guest experience layer for modern hospitality
about.heroSubtitle: Scerv is designed for restaurants that want the polish of enterprise technology without losing the warmth of great service.
about.missionP1: Dining should feel effortless for guests and manageable for the teams serving them. Too often, restaurants are forced to stitch together disconnected tools for reservations, ordering, payments, reviews, loyalty, and reporting.
about.missionP2: Scerv brings those moments into a cleaner hospitality experience so operators can move faster, understand guests better, and create more reasons for people to return.
about.marketP: New York is one of the most demanding hospitality markets in the world. Brooklyn alone spans neighborhood restaurants, bars, cafes, chef-driven concepts, nightlife, hotels, and ambitious independents. If a platform can respect service culture here, it can scale with credibility.
